Title: [Valid consent submission returns successful no-content response]
Description: Validate that the consents endpoint processes a fully valid request and completes the business flow with a successful no-content response.
Preconditions:
Valid authorization token is available.
Redis contains evidence that consent was shown to the customer.
Customer Agreement dependencies are available.
Valid consent test data is prepared.
Folder: Technical Tests > Backend > API Master Repository
Steps: 1. Send POST request to ms-lending-bs/v1/consents with valid authorization header.\n2. Include body with consents array containing idConsent and isAccepted.\n3. Verify request is accepted and processed end-to-end.
Results: 1. Response status is 200.\n2. Response body is empty according to documented contract.\n3. Consent flow is processed without validation or dependency errors.

Title: [Duplicate request resend consistency]
Description: Validate functional consistency when the same consent payload is resent as a duplicate request.
Preconditions:
Valid authorization token.
Redis confirms consent was shown.
Dependencies are available.
Stable valid payload is prepared.
Folder: Technical Tests > Backend > API Master Repository
Steps: 1. Send POST request with valid authorization and valid payload.\n2. Immediately resend the exact same request.\n3. Compare responses and downstream side effects between both executions.
Results: 1. Service behavior is consistent across duplicated submissions.\n2. No contradictory update/evaluate outcomes are produced for the same logical consent.\n3. Any non-idempotent behavior is documented as a risk if observed.
